name: METFORMIN 1000 MG 40 TABLETS
description: Metformin 1000 mg, in a 40-tablet presentation, is a first-line antihyperglycemic medication primarily used for the treatment and control of type 2 diabetes mellitus. General Information Purpose: Helps lower blood glucose levels by decreasing sugar production in the liver and improving the sensitivity of cells to insulin. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
